title: AG60062: Management And Productivity
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Organization and growth of farm; optimum allocation of resources; production
relationship; farm planning and budgeting; farm financial management;
management of land resources; farm labour management; farm machinery
management; agricultural price policy; production cost, supply and price
determination; risk and uncertainty; strategic management SWOT analysis;
creating strategic option/choice of a particular strategy; different types of
management control system; design and implementation issues; case studies from
Indian industries.
